title: Full Screen Remote Desktop with Key Remap on both server and client causes key to be sent twice.

judgment.rationale: The report provides a clear full-screen RDP reproduction with Caps Lock→Esc remapped on both computers; windowed RDP sends one Esc, while full-screen sends two. A 0.90.1 follow-up describes timing-dependent extra Caps Lock/Esc events. The reporter suspects the RDP client, so do not assume a PowerToys root cause.
evidence: The original steps specify identical Caps Lock→Esc mappings on both computers and full-screen RDP.
The expected single Esc is reported as two; windowed RDP behaves correctly.
A later 0.90.1 report reproduces extra key events only in full-screen mode.
The thread links #35142 as related, but not as an established fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Replay the same mapping in full-screen and windowed RDP on a current client and isolate whether duplicate events originate locally, remotely, or in the RDP client.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reproduction is concrete, but the reporter's evidence leaves the RDP client as a plausible owner. Confirm event origin on a current build before proposing a PowerToys change.

issue_context.summary: With Caps Lock→Esc remapped on both the local and remote computers, full-screen RDP reportedly delivers duplicate or extra key events, while windowed RDP delivers one.
known_information: Initial report used PowerToys 0.76.2, Windows 10 local, and Windows 11 remote.
A later report used PowerToys 0.90.1 and describes timing-dependent Caps Lock/Esc output in full-screen mode.
The reporter suspects the RDP client because another client behaved differently, but that is not proof of ownership.
Related issue #35142 is not an established resolution.
inferences: The duplication may arise from the RDP client's full-screen input forwarding, the interaction of two remapping engines, or both.
issue_context.analysis: The existing evidence is sufficient for a controlled reproduction, not for a code design. Compare event counts at local, remote, and RDP boundaries before assigning a PowerToys root cause.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and both comments, including the later 0.90.1 reproduction.
Checked linked references and current labels/assignees; no linked fix or assigned owner was found.

actions.label: Compare full-screen and windowed RDP event counts

reproduce.title: Test duplicated Caps Lock remaps through RDP
prerequisites: Current upstream main or current build on local and remote PCs
Caps Lock→Esc mapping on both systems
steps: Connect with RDP in windowed mode and press Caps Lock once; record the remote output.
Switch the same session to full-screen mode and repeat the same single press.
Repeat both modes with Keyboard Manager disabled on the client, then on the server, changing only one side at a time.
For each run, record the physical press count and the local/remote generated key events.
reproduce.expected_result: One physical press yields one Esc in each RDP mode; any duplicate is localized to a specific client/server remapping path.
